subject: Biology
scope: Preliminary same-subject semantic screening of all 200 Biology rows (169 retained, 31 held).
method: Compared all Biology question stems using padded character-trigram Dice similarity and manually inspected high-scoring candidate pairs, answer options and explanations. Lexical similarity is a triage signal, not a semantic decision by itself.
